text.description_html:
Omnia SD-720/220, Retro Back to Back Door Pulls

Retro styled satin stainless steel glass door pulls are 15" overall length with 8-5/8" center to center mounting hole spacing. It features a sleek design. The Retro Styling is now ultra modern, created with state-of-the-art technology by Omnia. Made from premium grade 304 solid stainless steel.

Also available as a Singe Retro Styled Stainless Steel Glass Door Pull for one side of door only.

Specifications for the Omnia SD-720/220-US32D Stainless Steel Glass Door Pulls:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 15"
  • Mounting Centers: 8-5/8" Center to Center Hole Spacing
  • Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Pull Diameter: 1-3/16" at Widest Point in Center of Pull
  • Mounting Brackets Diameter: 3/4"
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 5/8" thick glass doors.

Packaged with 2 door pulls, decorative nuts plus mounting hardware for mounting on 1/4" to 5/8" thick glass shower doors.
